implementation_delta: The native controls now recognize a narrowly verified Read numeric-string input rejection before a callback and preserve physical transcript positions without accepting blank or incomplete history (#2084/#2086). The rejected call must belong to a previously initialized native session and have a unique ordered error-only result, with no callback or conflicting execution evidence; no permission decision is fabricated. Renderer 14, its inherited shared audit record/artifact contract (#2078), renderer-13 Phase 1 correction and terminal-failure guidance, native phase-history checking (#2067), policy v4 and control contract v2 remain unchanged. All generation instruction identities are rebuilt only for the fresh paths and labels; sources, schemas, profiles and evaluation instruments remain fixed. Both arms receive a fresh condition and unused output paths. v10y remains incomplete after correctly stopping on omitted explicit receipt-command selectors before that checker executed; its full draft and receipt do not constitute an accepted final pair. This control fix addresses a separate defect and does not reinterpret the actual stop.
